proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1351 āryikā/āryakā explicitly gives Kalasha āya, Palula yēi and Torwali yäi “mother”, alongside Prakrit ajjiā “grandmother”. These named local mother-word comparanda support the parent. Comparative check: Tor yaī “mother” (f_fes5clee7jtzo). The exact survey spelling and semantic marks remain untouched. Equivalent elicitation glosses and ordinary inflections were reviewed together; source person, number, honorific and tense labels remain in the original record. The full form and sense support this same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.
